_note: uv sync --extra aigamestore: the vendored aigamestore-gym env (vendor/aigamestore), which needs a Chromium browser (system Chrome by default). Lock-stepped: fps must equal 60 / frame_skip (10 with the default frame_skip 6).
_levels_note: An episode is one level: it ends on a win, a loss or a level clear, and reset() restarts the same level. Levels 1..6 are listed, one phase each; drop or reorder them as the session needs.
_keys_note: The env's action is MultiBinary over the game's keys, in aigamestore_gym.GAME_KEYS order -- game5: 0=LEFT, 1=RIGHT, 2=UP -- so 'keys' values are those indices (the JSON key is what the subject presses) and held keys combine. The env relabels the on-canvas hints to the pressed key; keep the message Controls text in sync with 'keys' by hand.
